def smooth(a,b,x):
 t=np.clip((x-a)/(b-a),0,1);return t*t*(3-2*t)
def worldxy(x,y):return 11.5+.5*x+math.sqrt(3)/2*y,34+math.sqrt(3)/2*x-.5*y
def shore(z):
 return 8+math.sin(z*.14)*2+math.sin(z*.37+.4)*.6+2.2*math.exp(-((z+2.5)/3.6)**2)-.85*math.exp(-((z-2.5)/(3.6*.65))**2)
def terrain(x,y):

def savepng(name,a,color=True):

 if a.shape[2]==3:a=np.concatenate([a,np.full((*a.shape[:2],1),255,np.uint8)],axis=2)

 path.write_bytes(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+ck(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',w,h,8,6,0,0,0))+ck(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(b''.join(b'\x00'+r.tobytes() for r in a),6))+ck(b'IEND',b''))

 a=np.empty(len(im.pixels),np.float32);im.pixels.foreach_get(a);a=a.reshape(im.size[1],im.size[0],4);bpy.data.images.remove(im)
 a[:,:,:3]=a[:,:,:3]*np.array(factor);node.image=savepng(name+'_albedo',a)

 uv=me.uv_layers.new(name='UVMap')
 for p in me.polygons:
  axis=max(range(3),key=lambda i:abs(p.normal[i]));a,b=([1,2] if axis==0 else [0,2] if axis==1 else [0,1])
  for li in p.loop_indices:
   q=me.vertices[me.loops[li].vertex_index].co;uv.data[li].uv=(q[a]/1.6,q[b]/1.6)

  [(0,3,2,1),(0,1,5,4),(1,2,6,5),(2,3,7,6),(3,0,4,7),(4,5,6,7)],mat)
 if bevel:
  b=o.modifiers.new('Dressed stone edges','BEVEL');b.width=bevel;b.segments=1

 return o
def retire(o):
 archive.objects.link(o);craft.objects.unlink(o);o['ground14_replaced']=True
retired=[]
for o in list(craft.objects):

  retired.append(o.name);retire(o)
# Two continuous stone work strips: staggered, broad flags instead of 88 equal tiles.
slabs=[]
for side in [-1,1]:
 for row in range(2):
  x0=1.754+row*1.2565;x1=x0+1.2565
  seq=([-5.297,-3.54,-1.06,1.08,2.856] if (row+(side>0))%2 else [-5.297,-4.18,-1.96,.48,2.856])
  for j,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(seq[:-1],seq[1:])):

   slabs.append(box('M14 working flag %d %d %d'%(side,row,j),(lo+.004,a+.004,1.47),(hi-.004,b-.004,1.62),pave,.006).name)
# Broad three-course bearing walls with separate long and short blocks.
edges=[(-4.36,-5.40,-4.36,2.85),(4.36,-5.40,4.36,2.85),(-4.30,-5.42,-1.57,-5.42),(1.57,-5.42,4.30,-5.42)]
walls=[]
for k,(x0,y0,x1,y1) in enumerate(edges):
 A=Vector((x0,y0,0));B=Vector((x1,y1,0));D=(B-A).normalized();P=Vector((-D.y,D.x,0));L=(B-A).length
 for row,(bottom,top) in enumerate([(0.01,.44),(.448,.95),(.958,1.48)]):
  lengths=[1.57,2.11,1.32,1.83,2.42] if (k+row)%2 else [1.08,1.93,2.30,1.48,2.06]
  cursor=0
  for j,length in enumerate(lengths):
   if cursor>=L-.015:break
   end=min(L,cursor+length)
   if L-end<.42:end=L
   # Fill each course firmly; shallow joints, with distinct course heights.
   pts=[]
   for z in [bottom,top]:
    for t,depth in [(cursor+.006,-.13),(end-.006,-.13),(end-.006,.13),(cursor+.006,.13)]:
     p=A+D*t+P*depth;pts.append((p.x,p.y,z))
   ob=mesh('M14 bearing course %d %d %d'%(k,row,j),pts,[(0,3,2,1),(4,5,6,7),(0,1,5,4),(1,2,6,5),(2,3,7,6),(3,0,4,7)],damp if row==0 else stone)
   be=ob.modifiers.new('Quarried arris','BEVEL');be.width=.012 if j%3 else .018;be.segments=1
   no=ob.modifiers.new('Broad stone normals','WEIGHTED_NORMAL');no.keep_sharp=True
   walls.append(ob.name);cursor=end
# A wider landward stair and a landing, joined to the raised bank.
stairs=[]
for i,(inner,outer,top) in enumerate([(4.255,4.89,1.42),(4.875,5.51,1.22),(5.495,6.15,1.02)]):
 stairs.append(box('M14 shore stair %d'%i,(inner,-1.54,.54),(outer,.72,top),stone,.009).name)
 box('M14 shore tread %d'%i,(inner-.015,-1.56,top-.065),(outer+.022,.74,top+.006),pave,.006)
# Hand-shaped continuous bank: raised ground wraps the sides and back,
# while the open repair basin is explicitly excluded from this mesh.
xs=sorted(set([round(-8+i*.4,4) for i in range(49)]+[-4.48,4.48]))
ys=sorted(set([round(-3.6+i*.4,4) for i in range(44)]+[2.65]))
verts=[];colors=[]
for y in ys:
 for x in xs:
  wx,wz=worldxy(x,y);base=terrain(x,y);off=wx-shore(wz)
  main=(1-smooth(4.7,8.0,abs(x)))*smooth(1.4,3.1,y)*(1-smooth(9.2,12.6,y))
  side=(1-smooth(6.4,9.1,abs(x)))*smooth(3.95,4.9,x)*(1-smooth(1.5,4.0,abs(y+.35)))
  weight=max(main,side)*smooth(.4,2.3,off)
  raised=max(0,1.32-base)*main + max(0,1.015-base)*side*(1-main)
  raised*=smooth(.4,2.3,off)
  # Broad, low irregular shoulders, not per-vertex noise.
  raised*=.97+.03*math.sin(x*.71+y*.34)
  h=base+raised-.025*(1-smooth(0,.055,raised))
  verts.append((x,y,h))
  tint=np.array([179,170,137])/255
  distance=abs(x-(6.3+.18*y))

faces=[];W=len(xs)
for j in range(len(ys)-1):
 for i in range(len(xs)-1):
  mx=(xs[i]+xs[i+1])*.5;my=(ys[j]+ys[j+1])*.5

col=bank.data.color_attributes.new(name='GroundTint',type='FLOAT_COLOR',domain='CORNER')
for p in bank.data.polygons:
 p.use_smooth=True

bank.data.color_attributes.active_color_index=0;bank.data.color_attributes.render_color_index=0
